Who has access (restricted)?
Backup-DR-Operator (start restores, cannot delete), Compliance-Auditor (view backup and restore-test records), Security-IncidentResponder (emergency, alerted)
NOTE:
Nobody can delete or shorten backups: not workload teams and not IT admins. Enforced by a vault lock and a guardrail on the Infrastructure OU.

span.span: 1. Production, Client-facing, and on-prem systems send their backups here.
2. Backups are copied to us- east-2 for disaster recovery (needs client approval).
3. Restores go back to the workloads, started by the Backup-DR-Operator role.
4. Access is restricted: operators can restore but not delete, auditors can view records.
